title: Adjoint-based gradient methods for inverse design in a multiple fragmentation model
summary: We study an inverse design problem for the linear multiple fragmentation equation arising in particle dynamics. Our objective is to reconstruct an unknown initial size distribution that evolves, under a prescribed fragmentation law, into a desired size distribution at a specified final time. We first establish the existence of global mass-conserving solutions for a broad class of fragmentation kernels with unbounded rates, and subsequently prove the continuous dependence and uniqueness of these solutions under additional assumptions on the fragmentation kernels.
